The fix is minimal and correct, and the generated codegen files are consistent with it.

## Summary

The `posts.archive` route was defined with `:date*` (`routes/web.ts:35`), which isn't a Hono catch-all pattern — Hono only matches params against a single path segment (`[^/]+`), and treats the trailing `*` as part of the literal param **name** (`"date*"`, not `date`). That's why `/posts/archive/2026/08` 404'd (no single segment can match `2026/08`) and `/posts/archive/2026` 422'd (the parsed param key was `date*`, so `ArchiveParamSchema`'s required `date` field came back missing). Hono's actual syntax for a param that captures the rest of the path including slashes is `:name{.+}`.

I changed the route to `posts.get('/archive/:date{.+}', ...)` in `routes/web.ts`, which requires no controller or validator changes since the captured param key is now correctly named `date`, matching what `PostController.archive` and `ArchiveParamSchema` already expect. I regenerated the derived route files (`.guren/routes.gen.ts`, `.guren/api-client.gen.ts`) via `bun run codegen` to keep them in sync. I also added a `posts.archive` test suite to `tests/PostController.test.ts` that creates real posts via the DB and exercises `/posts/archive/YYYY/MM` (both zero-padded and not), `/posts/archive/YYYY`, an empty period, and an out-of-range month (422), cleaning up its fixtures in `afterAll`. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (7/7) both pass.
